description: This file defines a static class 'MessagingInstruments' that contains metrics and instrumentation logic for messaging within the Orleans runtime, including counters, histograms, and methods to record various messaging events.

classes.name: MessagingInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing metrics and instrumentation methods for messaging events within Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnMessageExpired
methods.description: Records an expired message event with the specified phase.

methods.name: OnPingSend
methods.description: Records a ping sent event to a specified destination address.

methods.name: OnPingReceive
methods.description: Records a ping received event from a specified destination address.

methods.name: OnPingReplyReceived
methods.description: Records a reply received for a ping from a specified replier address.

methods.name: OnPingReplyMissed
methods.description: Records a missed ping reply from a specified replier address.

methods.name: OnFailedSentMessage
methods.description: Records a failed sent message event, if the message has a direction.

methods.name: OnDroppedSentMessage
methods.description: Records a dropped sent message event, if the message has a direction.

methods.name: OnRejectedMessage
methods.description: Records a rejected message event, if the message has a direction.

methods.name: OnMessageReceive
methods.description: Records a message reception event, including size and optional remote silo address.

methods.name: OnMessageSend
methods.description: Records a message send event, including size and optional remote silo address.
